titulo: Quiz — Being invited to someone's table
subtitulo: Say yes, arrive with something, leave after the tea
introPt: An invitation to Sunday lunch, accepted on the spot, and the offer to bring something.
cenario: On the pavement outside a café, three days after meeting.

dialogo.es: 日曜日、うちに昼ごはんに来ませんか。一時ごろ。
dialogo.pt: Come to lunch at ours on Sunday. Around one.
dialogo.tts: 日曜日、うちに昼ごはんに来ませんか。一時ごろ。

dialogo.es: 喜んで。お招きありがとうございます。何か持って行きましょうか？
dialogo.pt: With pleasure, thank you for the invitation. Shall I bring something?
dialogo.tts: 喜んで。お招きありがとうございます。何か持って行きましょうか？

dialogo.es: いえいえ、手ぶらで来てくださいね！
dialogo.tts: いえいえ、手ぶらで来てくださいね！

dialogo.es: デザートを持ってきました。お口に合うといいのですが。
dialogo.pt: I brought a dessert, I hope you'll like it.
dialogo.tts: デザートを持ってきました。お口に合うといいのですが。

perguntas.pergunta: Teburade de kite kudasai — come empty-handed — means:
opcoes: Arrive with nothing, they mean it literally
It is part of the exchange — you still arrive with a temiyage
Bring money instead
The invitation has been withdrawn
perguntas.explica: The refusal of your offer is part of the form. A boxed sweet or a bottle works, handed over for the table.

perguntas.pergunta: The invitation says ichiji goro — around one. How seriously is that hour meant?
opcoes: Loosely — anything up to three is fine
It means the door opens at one and lunch is at three
Seriously — mealtimes are measured and fairly fixed, and the meal runs long
Hours are never named
perguntas.explica: Time-use surveys show meals at fairly fixed hours; arrive on time, or a couple of minutes early.

perguntas.pergunta: Everyone is standing round the table. What do you do?
opcoes: Ask — doko ni suwareba ii desu ka
Take the nearest chair
Wait outside the room
Sit at the head, as the guest
perguntas.explica: A room has a kamiza and a shimoza; a guest is shown to a place. Hand the decision back to the host.

opcoes: A short speech from the guest
A fixed word — glasses up, kanpai, done
Only for formal dinners
Something the host does alone
perguntas.explica: No speech is expected of a guest, and none of the host either.

perguntas.pergunta: Someone says keigo ja nakute ii desu yo. What has happened?
opcoes: You were rude and are being corrected
You must now use casual speech with everyone in the room
The switch to casual speech is being offered — accept it, but never go first
It is a question about the food
perguntas.explica: Desu-masu is the default with any adult you did not grow up with; the move to casual is proposed out loud.
